summary: Production stewardship resumed from the stable V15 four-seat-preflight checkpoint; its 25-event source segment rehashed to 853d07097ada195065d7c3e7672798f6a17e4d9942a246e85692b4ff8b1339fc.

The shared-workspace snapshot contained 1,889 files, 157 recent files, 15 active files, and zero active shared seams; all writes remained inside lane 015 while foreign 013, 016, 017, and 018 activity was left untouched.
ADB was unavailable, zero Android devices were exposed, and no present mobile-device substrate was available, so the four-real-phone intended-router run could not execute.
The external 30-minute four-phone gate remained a SUBSTRATE plus EVIDENCE gap; browser tabs and API sessions were used only for local software verification and were never counted as phones.
V15 proved exactly one live controller per seat but did not require that each controller visibly acknowledge its assigned P1-P4 identity before the qualification clock could start.
V16 adds axm.mirrorshift-seat-confirmation/v1 and requires exactly one connected and explicitly confirmed controller session on every P1-P4 seat before LAN qualification can start.

POST /api/seat-confirm accepts only an existing matching controller-kind session in the lobby; screen sessions and mismatched or expired identities are rejected, and confirmation changes no gameplay authority.
Same-session controller reload restores the server-held acknowledgement; a new session identity or authority-process replacement starts unconfirmed and must acknowledge the seat again.
Transport telemetry exposes additive seatConfirmed and seatConfirmCount fields per session, while launcher metadata exposes the confirmation path/schema and responses retain no session identifier.

The privacy-bounded preflight now reports confirmed-seat counts and an unconfirmed status; START remains disabled for an otherwise healthy but unconfirmed seat and the receipt records controllerSeatConfirmationsReady.
Each controller reuses its existing secondary action: CONFIRM P# in the lobby before acknowledgement and START afterward, with busy-state protection against repeated confirmation posts.

The host differentiates live sessions from confirmations, names every unconfirmed controller, keeps 4/4 live distinct from 4/4 confirmed, and exposes the physical-phone/router boundary in its passing copy.

A confirmation gesture acknowledges only one controller session's seat assignment; it cannot prove who tapped, that the client is a phone, that four independent people are present, or that the intended router is in use.

Focused LAN cases pass a connected-but-unconfirmed P3 negative and preserve the 101-snapshot qualification contract; HTTP cases pass unconfirmed creation, controller confirmation, same-session resume, screen rejection, and telemetry receipts.
The regenerated comparator remains honestly UNKNOWN with zero missing capabilities; qa.four-phone-lan.controller-seat-confirmation is available while qa.physical-four-phone-lan remains unknown.
Four local controller tabs produced 4/4 live but zero confirmations; every host seat read CONFIRM ON CONTROLLER and START QUALIFICATION remained disabled.

Each real controller UI exposed one unique CONFIRM P# action, changed to START after one click, and updated its link copy to SEAT # // CONFIRMED; the host enabled only after all four reached 1 LIVE, 1 SESSION, and 1 CONFIRM.
Reloading the confirmed P1 controller restored SEAT 1 // CONFIRMED and START from the same server session, while the host remained qualification-ready.

A bounded 10.108-second start/stop probe recorded lanSeatConfirmationsReady true, authorityWrites zero, status partial, and physicalGateVerdict requiring external steward review; no physical attestation was used.
The host and all four controller tabs reported zero warning/error console entries throughout the confirmation, reload, and partial-receipt journey.

Default-surface screenshots and semantic snapshots proved the local interaction states, but the browser's advertised 390x844 override left both existing and newly opened tabs at 1280x720; a reset also exposed a device-pixel-ratio capture crop, so current portrait confirmation pixels remain UNKNOWN.

Final npm test passed 34 focused gameplay checks, 45,504 interpolation poses, 864 snaps, the 108,000-frame target recorder, four-confirmation-gated LAN qualification, managed bind, 24/36/72 race matrices, 32 battles, 30 virtual reliability minutes, restart recovery, and HTTP coverage; observed reliability heap delta was 6 MB.
Focused package verification reported zero errors and one expected physical-phone warning; the verifier selftest passed 15 assertions and all 16 lane JSON files parsed.
The broad Game Hub verifier reported exactly nine failures, all in untouched foreign 016-hexbound-rooftops; MIRRORSHIFT retained zero errors.

The supervised port-8805 runtime remained healthy from current V16 source, reported PLAYABLE ALPHA V16 - CONTROLLER SEATS CONFIRMED on managed 0.0.0.0 in the lobby, and retained only the screen session after controller-tab cleanup; the pointer remains explicitly ephemeral.

Mike, Axiom/Mir, Codex, and Mirror; equal 260 max, 178 acceleration, and 2.45 turn; the +7.5 percent catch-up ceiling; 85 percent race attacks; repairable three-segment Flux Guard; and server authority remain unchanged.
